cohort: Pregnant women diagnosed with gestational diabetes mellitus (GDM) whose babies were delivered in a Chinese hospital between July 2017 and June 2020.
finding: Preeclampsia in women with GDM was significantly associated with higher risks of fetal malformations, fetal growth restriction, cesarean section, emergency cesarean section, preterm birth, low birth weight, small for gestational age, and neonatal hypoglycemia.
mod_finding: Preeclampsia in women with GDM was associated with a higher risk of both cesarean section and emergency cesarean section.
